```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyfinance)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
prices <- download_data(type = "stock_prices",
                         symbols = c("AAPL","NVDA", "JPM", "MSFT", "GOOGL", "LLY", "GOOG", "META", "ASML", "HSBC", "GS", "NESN.SW", "AMZN", "TSLA", "NEE", "CBA.AX", "WELL", "BRK-B", "NEM", "SU", "JNJ", "SIE.DE", "MU", "7203.T", "AMD", "CSCO", "ORCL", "XOM", "CAT", "ABBV"),
                         start_date = "2016-01-01",
                         end_date = "2026-04-21")
  
```

```{r}
returns <- prices %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  arrange(date) %>% 
  mutate(ret = adjusted_close/lag(adjusted_close)-1) %>% 
  select(symbol, date, ret) %>% 
  drop_na(ret)

```
```{r}
returns %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = ret,
             color = symbol)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  facet_wrap(~symbol, scale = "free_y") + 
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
trading_volume <- prices %>% 
  group_by(symbol, date) %>% 
  summarize(trading_volume = sum(adjusted_close*volume))

trading_volume %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date,
             y = trading_volume,
             colour = symbol))+
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~symbol, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = "M", scale = 1e-9)) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       title = "Trading volume for Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
prices <- prices %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  mutate(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(n == max(n)) %>% 
  select(-n)

returns <- prices %>% 
  group_by(symbol, date) %>% 
  summarize(price = last(adjusted_close), .groups = "drop_last") %>% 
  mutate(dailyret = price/lag(price)-1) %>% 
  drop_na(dailyret) %>% 
  select(-price)

assets <- returns %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  summarize(mu = mean(dailyret),
            var = var(dailyret))
```
```{r}
assets %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = var,
             y = mu,
             label = symbol)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Volatility",
       y = "Expected return",
       title = "Expected returns and volatilities") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
returns_wide <- returns %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = symbol,
              values_from = dailyret)

sigma <- returns_wide %>% 
  select(-date) %>% 
  cov()

sigma %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "symbol_a") |> 
  pivot_longer(-symbol_a, names_to = "symbol_b") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = symbol_a, y = fct_rev(symbol_b), fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Covariance",
    title = "Sample covariance matrix of selected assets"
  ) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "blue",
  mid = "white",
  high = "red"
)  +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 0.5))
```
